items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Oscar Peterson just called me... Ray agreed to make the tour, to go to Japan... Oscar took his rhythm section

ctx.x: So, he sound on Hayes. Hayes called my room, said, 'Man, you know, Oscar Peterson just called me. Did he call you?' I said yeah. 'Are
you going?" "You damn right I'm going." Said, 3-19 me too." So he called Hayes first. They had a tour to do in Japan. I didn't know....Ray agreed to make the tour, to go to Japan. So Hayes left.
